articles.title: Trump to meet with senators over CLARITY Act on Thursday: Politico
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump is set to meet with several senators on Thursday as negotiators race to get the CLARITY Act across the line before the Senate’s August recess.

articles.title: Stanford study says 5-minute Bitcoin prediction markets enable settlement manipulation
articles.snippet: Researchers found that Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin prediction markets create incentives to manipulate spot prices around contract settlement, proposing longer settlement windows as a potential fix.
